reviews.t: Love this stuff
reviews.x: Literally the best foundation I've ever used and I've basically tried them all. I have ultra oily skin and live in an 99% humidity environment so foundation is a huge struggle. This cushion goes on so smooth, and though it goes on a bit dewy, I just pat a bit of finishing powder on and it's perfect all day. It's even improved the look of my skin and after a week of use, didn't clog my pores or cause any breakouts. Definitely worth a try if you're considering.

reviews.t: Wish it had darker shade
reviews.x: The color is a bit too pale for my liking, even though I am a light skinned Asian.  Wish it came in a darker shade.  It covers well, but I notice my dry areas (mostly cheeks) become a bit chalky by end of the day after 10+ hours.  If you have dry skin and need to wear the makeup for a long day, make sure you moisturize well and do touch ups throughout the day.  It's not shiny like some cushions, more matte.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the smooth, long-lasting coverage and dewy finish, with many calling it the best foundation they have used.
Several reviewers note the single shade runs too dark or beige for very fair skin, though some fair users say it still works when applied sparingly.
The included refill and nice packaging are commonly appreciated as good value for the price.
Some users with oily or combination skin report needing primer or powder, and that using too much product can look cakey or crepey.
A few reviewers wish refills could be purchased separately for environmental and practical reasons.
